lastSummary: NC-015 fixed: Model capability detection replaced brittle hardcoded name heuristic with versioned ModelCapabilityRegistry. (1) New ModelCapabilityRegistry class with 40+ static entries covering ollama, openai-compatible, huggingface, groq, together, openrouter, fireworks, nvidia providers. (2) Registry keyed by provider-qualified model IDs (e.g. 'ollama:qwen3:8b'). (3) Three-tier lookup: user overrides > provider metadata > static registry > conservative heuristic fallback. (4) Unknown models now get 32K context (was 64K), no thinking, no tool calling — conservative defaults prevent silent capability assumptions. (5) User overrides via registerUserOverride() for explicit config. (6) Provider metadata via registerProviderMetadata() for runtime capability discovery. (7) detectModelCapabilities() uses registry first, falls back to heuristic for unrecognized models. (8) Singleton pattern with resetModelCapabilityRegistry() for test isolation. (9) 63 regression tests in modelCapabilities.test.ts: static registry (12), unknown models (4), user overrides (3), provider metadata (2), makeKey (4), singleton (2), clearOverrides (1), has (3), size (2), detectModelCapabilities registry-backed (6), conservative heuristic fallback (4), heuristic for unrecognized (4), backward compatibility (14), integration (3). 1203/1203 tests pass (3 pre-existing e2e failures). Build clean. All type-checks clean.
